details: This package is a dependency-resolution canary / proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs probe.cjs, which sends a single HTTPS POST to hxxps://webhook[.]site/a4bf0f9f-6d96-46e6-80ac-b76a5329f481 with the fixed body "HELPER_AGENT_INSTALL_CANARY" (Content-Type: text/plain). The request body is a hardcoded literal: the package collects no host metadata, environment variables, credentials, tokens, or file contents, and it has no other behaviour — no dependencies, no bin, no second stage, no persistence. Installing it simply notifies the callback host that the package was installed. The package describes itself as an authorized HTB dependency-resolution canary.
